Ordering: (1) the RC17 touch-floor fix in base.css must land before the per-component hit-target items or they get patched one by one. (2) CM-25 (self-contained items) and the W0 content gates must precede CM-02's shuffle. (3) GO-23's RAG rewrite fixes CM-18 and changes Goals' 'Move topics to Green', RAG on topic pages, Home and Reports; it needs a 'no claim yet' band that touches several readers (Study, Exams readiness EX-47 coverage, Goals), so schedule it with the W7 'automatic judgements' shared rule and fixtures. User decision Q8 (pro-rata log vs resumable) blocks that cluster. (5) JM-13 and MI-05 pay rewards on failing evidence; RC21 receipts + a clawback decision (MI-05 noted; JM-13 the same question). (6) GO-02 must measure from the media activity journal (invariant 99); this is the user's question about untouched anime/manga appearing as 'done': DI-27 (hotfixed) stopped the cross-module MAL-id flip that kept writing journal events, but already-written spurious journal entries and score-only events still count. The user's new rule (a score change is not progress) belongs with GO-02 and the Reports/Recently-updated readers (other group's HR findings): only progress/volumes/route/chapter/hours/status-to-completed should count as 'done this period'; score and other status moves should not. Plan writer should add a DI-27 journal clean-up (drop events from the flip) and a shared 'counts as activity' predicate over the journal used by Goals, Reports and Home. (7) ST-08/JM-24 hero unification overlaps RC16 (shared lesson reader, W8); do the CSS now, the module extraction later. JM-02 (Mind inspector missing status block) is best done as the shared inspector helper from RC16.
